evidence.text: The chapel wall gives the same text twice: the old version, then a rewrite with updated spelling, 3 words replaced and 4 words dropped.
The scraped tablet is full of exactly the 4 dropped words.
Storeroom wall: "Some of these marks were scraped away on purpose." The damage is all in the old-style part.
The newer horn/moon texts (table, niche, wall's second half) are barely damaged.
The replaced words open the text and recur, like names. Maybe a god or ruler swapped for another.
A hand in a beaded border marks the token and the pitcher: an owner or authority.
The temple door feels "wrong" everywhere inside the temple.

guess: An official rewrite removed certain words, and the old records were scraped to match
next: What do the dropped and replaced words mean? Watch for them on new inscriptions, objects, and the temple's closed stair.
